description: This PHP source file defines a web page for configuring and debugging VoIP service provider settings, specifically for voice diagnostics. It includes functions for retrieving settings via getStr, renders a form for server IP, port, and gain settings, and contains JavaScript for handling user interactions and AJAX requests to apply configurations.

methods.name: Dm_data_get
methods.description: Retrieves current VoIP debug configuration settings such as ingress and egress gains, SIP log server IP, port, and SIP status.
